text:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — proposing a lightweight invite playbook for a 6-week beta focused on latency-sensitive inference use cases. Want feedback on recruitment copy, screening, and launch gates. Timeline aim: start outreach next Mon.
Aaron (PM Research): +1. Can we surface expected customer personas? e.g., realtime chat, docs summarization at 100ms target.
Maya (PM): Personas: "realtime chat" (customer-facing UI), "workflows" (batch + short-turn latency), and "vector-search + rerank" high QPS.
Priya (Design): Suggest adding a short product usage checklist in the screener to measure fit. "Have you integrated an LLM into a user-facing feature?" Yes/No.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Ops question — do we have Dedicated capacity slots to promise predictable throughput for any committed DP? Need to avoid overpromising.
Maya (PM): We can promise a canary Dedicated pool for up to 2 partners concurrently, or hosted with SLA-like guidance. Will document fallbacks.
Sam (SRE): Also need to add a fallback policy for degraded throughput. I can draft a routing policy snippet.
Chris (Legal): Quick flag: if we're asking for logs or customer data for debugging, we need consent language and a minimal DPIA check. Keep NDA simple but include allowed data types.
Maya (PM): Good catch. We'll have a standard short consent clause in outreach.
deply-bot: deploy job #875 merged to beta/invite-playbook (main -> beta) :party_parrot:
Aaron (PM Research): Screener draft — short list of questions (1-2 minute form). Please comment: ```
1) Brief description of the feature you'd use Redwood for
2) Avg request qps and p95 latency requirement
3) Typical input lengths (tokens) and concurrency
4) Any regulatory constraints (PHI, PCI, GDPR)
5) Point of contact + dev time estimate to integrate (hours)
```
Priya (Design): LGTM. Add a small item: "What does success look like for you?" as a checkbox list (reduced latency / cost savings / accuracy parity).
Elena (Solutions Eng): For prioritization scoring, propose: fit score (1-5), integration effort (1-5), business impact (1-5). We'll accept a combined >=11 to invite. Thoughts?
Maya (PM): Sounds fair. Also add a "data sensitivity" veto for anything requiring on-prem only.
Sam (SRE): Launch gates proposal: 
- Gate 1 (Recruit): >= 10 qualified signups with diversity across personas
- Gate 2 (Onboard readiness): 3 partners with basic integration validated in staging
- Gate 3 (Quality): No regression >10% in 1 key eval metric across partners
- Gate 4 (Ops): Runbook + fallback verified; latency SLOs documented
If any gate fails, pause outreach.
Aaron (PM Research): For success metrics, we should capture: median latency, cost per 1k tokens, and a qualitative NPS after week 4.
Maya (PM): Agreed. Also require partners to run a short evaluation harness we provide (they run 3 canonical prompts and return outputs).
Chris (Legal): I'll draft a 1-paragraph consent block & a short data handling note. Ping me for any dataset requests.
Priya (Design): Incentive options: early access + $500 credit, or a joint case study offer. Which works better for enterprise vs startups?
Elena (Solutions Eng): Startups prefer credits; enterprise values co-marketing and SLAs. We should include both as options in outreach.
Maya (PM): Outreach templates: 1) short email for cold reach, 2) longer briefing for inbound leads. I'll post copies later.
Sam (SRE): Operational note: please include contact hours for oncall coverage during the 6-week beta (we'll provide a calendar and a primary/responders list).
Aaron (PM Research): One small experiment: split invite copy A/B — "help shape latency" vs "reduce cost" — track conversion.
Maya (PM): Nice. We'll measure conversion and time-to-first-integration.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Quick technical checklist to add to onboarding: 
- API key created + scoped
- Model pinned/version noted
- Baseline eval artifacts uploaded
- Traffic routing plan (canary %)
Include that in the staging checklist.
Chris (Legal): Also add a simple data retention window we can offer (30/90/365 days) for logs. Prefer to default 30.
Priya (Design): I'll create a short in-product banner copy for partners: "You're in our latency beta — here's how we'll work together" with a CTA to onboarding docs.
Maya (PM): Next steps: I'll consolidate into a 1-page invite playbook: recruitment screener, scoring rubric, launch gates, onboarding checklist, incentive options, legal consent snippet. Action owners: Aaron (screener final), Priya (banner + copy), Elena (scoring rubric + staging checklist), Sam (ops gates/runbook), Chris (consent + retention). I'll circulate by EOD Friday.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Happy to help with invite triage when it starts.
Sam (SRE): I'll stub the runbook templates and ping for review.
Aaron (PM Research): I'll set up a tiny form and an A/B experiment in HubSpot.
Priya (Design): +1. 
Chris (Legal): Will review the final playbook.
Maya (PM): Great — thanks everyone. If no objections, we'll start outreach next Monday. :rocket:
